A+ atmosphere and service
Oct 2026 • Couples
We are always on the lookout for a great rooftop bar when we travel. It was our first time in Saigon, and we stumbled across SOUL. Jollie was our server, and was incredibly nice, even when we had to move inside when it started down pouring. She even brought us an umbrella to move inside. We got the draught Bia Siagon, fresh spring rolls, and pho bo—and everything was delicious. We ordered more beer to wait out the rain storm, and they brought us delicious spicy peanuts and cut fruit. The atmosphere was fantastic and the bathrooms were also very clean. Definitely recommend!
